outcome: Placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) diagnosis and severity (FIGO clinical classification)
cohort: 229 pregnant women, including those with placenta accreta spectrum (n=76), placenta previa (n=77), and healthy controls (n=76), who delivered at a tertiary hospital between January 2023 and January 2025.
finding: Lower mean platelet volume (MPV) and platelet distribution width (PDW) were significantly associated with high hypervascularization in placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) cases.
